description: This file contains the implementation of FastAPI-based pass-through endpoints and utility functions for proxying requests, including HTTP and WebSocket passthrough, handling various content types, extracting models from WebSocket messages, and managing pass-through routes with optional guardrails and custom headers. It serves as a core component for forwarding requests to various backend models or services, with detailed logging and error handling.
